title: 第4章边城急报铁刃归京第5章御街围捕四面绝途
content_zh:
天启二十七年，冬。
北境的雪，从来都比中原来得凶烈。鹅毛大雪连绵半月，将绵延千里的雁门边关彻底封冻，苍茫天地间只剩一片死寂的白。凛冽北风卷着碎雪，狠狠撞在雁门关的青石城墙上，发出呜咽般的呼啸，像是无数亡魂在旷野低声悲鸣。城墙垛口覆着厚厚的冰棱，层层叠叠，锋利如刃，映着暗沉的天光，泛着冷冽刺骨的寒光。
城关之上，一身玄铁重甲的铁寻柳静立风雪之中。
他身形挺拔如松，脊背笔直，肩背扛着常年戍边沉淀的风霜与厚重。玄铁铠甲久经战阵，遍体深浅不一的刀痕箭伤，每一道纹路都是浴血厮杀的印记，甲片缝隙里嵌着未化的冰雪与干涸的暗红血痂，新旧交错，触目惊心。寒风掀起他肩头的黑色披风，宽大的衣摆猎猎作响，在漫天白雪里划出凌厉的弧线，衬得他周身气场冷肃凛冽，不怒自威。
铁寻柳驻守雁门五年。
五年光阴，他以一柄寒铁长刀镇守北境咽喉，硬生生将屡次南下进犯的北蛮铁骑挡在关外，寸步难进。世人皆称，北境有铁寻柳，便是国门无虞、百姓安枕。民间甚至流传一句谚语：铁刃镇边关，风雪不渡江。于大靖王朝而言，铁寻柳早已不是单纯的镇边将领，而是北境百姓的定心丸，是朝堂抵御外侮的一柄最锋利、最可靠的利刃。
此刻，他垂眸望着关外茫茫雪原，眼底沉如寒潭，无半分波澜。雪原之上，枯草覆雪，冻土千里，偶尔可见几处被战火焚毁的荒寨残垣，静默伫立在风雪之中，无声诉说着往年战事的惨烈。脚下这片土地，浸透了将士的热血，埋葬了无数忠骨，也刻满了他五年戍边的坚守与孤勇。
“将军，风雪太大，入帐避寒吧。”亲兵校尉林策快步上前，身上甲胄落满白雪，眉宇间带着几分焦灼与敬重，“将士们已轮番巡城完毕，北蛮近日毫无异动，暂无隐患。”
铁寻柳微微摇头，嗓音因常年吹沐北风而低沉沙哑，自带一股风霜沉淀的厚重：“越是风雪封关，越不能松懈。北蛮最善趁雪夜潜行偷袭，不可掉以轻心。”
他抬手，指尖抚过腰间冰凉的刀柄。这柄寒铁长刀伴随他征战十载，刀身历经无数次劈砍搏杀，依旧寒光凛冽，刀锋锋利无匹，出鞘可斩风雪，可破敌胆。五年戍边，大小战事七十余场，他凭此刀守雁门、破敌阵、护苍生，从未一败。
林策闻言躬身应是，只是眉宇间的忧虑未曾散去：“将军戍边五载，冬守严寒，夏沐风沙，从未休沐。朝中诸多将领年年轮换回京，唯有将军固守此地，未曾踏回过京城半步。”
铁寻柳闻言，薄唇微抿，眼底掠过一丝极淡的漠然。
他不是不愿归京，是不敢，也不能。
他手握北境十万镇边精兵，兵权在握，镇守王朝咽喉重地，功高最易震主。当今圣上萧景渊，少年登基，城府深沉，心思难测，最是忌惮边关大将拥兵自重。五年前，他主动请命戍守北境，远离朝堂纷争，既是为守家国安宁，亦是为避朝堂猜忌，求一个君臣相安、边境太平。
京城繁华，风波诡谲，从来都不是他该久留之地。边关苦寒，却胜在坦荡纯粹，刀对刀、枪对枪，胜败皆凭实力，远胜过朝堂之上的尔虞我诈、暗流汹涌。
就在二人低语之际，远处天际忽然传来一阵急促的鹰唳，尖锐凌厉，刺破风雪的沉寂。
铁寻柳眸光骤然一凝，抬眸望向天空。只见一只通体乌黑的皇家传信雄鹰，顶着凛冽风雪，振翅疾驰而来，羽翼翻飞间，抖落片片白雪，速度极快，径直朝着雁门关城楼飞来。
林策脸色瞬间肃然：“是京城御鹰！加急密信！”
寻常军情、地方文书，皆由驿站快马传递，唯有皇宫专属的紧急诏令、绝密消息，才会动用皇家御鹰。且御鹰千里奔袭，冒雪而来，足见事态紧急，绝非寻常小事。
转瞬之间，御鹰落至城楼栏杆之上，爪上牢牢系着一枚玄色锦囊，囊身绣着细密的金色龙纹，是皇家专属规制，一眼可辨。

林策上前小心翼翼解下锦囊，不敢有半分怠慢，双手捧着递至铁寻柳面前：“将军，是宫中急诏。”
铁寻柳伸手接过，指尖触到锦囊微凉的触感，心底莫名升起一丝沉郁。他指尖用力，拆开锦囊封口，取出一卷明黄色的圣旨。
圣旨质地为上等云锦，金线织就的龙纹威严庄重，墨字工整凌厉，字字皆是帝王笔迹，笔锋沉敛，带着不容置喙的帝王威仪。短短数行文字，却让铁寻柳原本沉静无波的眼眸，彻底掀起万丈波澜。
【奉天承运，皇帝诏曰：镇北将军铁寻柳戍边五载，镇守国门，劳苦功高。今京中有事，急召铁寻柳即刻卸兵权，轻装归京，即刻入朝复命，不得延误。北境军务暂由副将代领，钦此。】
字字简洁，句句决绝。
没有缘由，没有铺垫，没有解释京中究竟出了何事，只一道冰冷的诏令，命他即刻卸去镇守五年的北境兵权，火速归京。
林策站在一旁，悄悄瞥见圣旨内容，瞬间脸色煞白，周身寒意骤起。他跟随铁寻柳多年，深知这道急诏的分量，心中骤然一紧，低声急道：“将军！陛下为何突然急召您回京？此时北境初定，民心、军心皆未稳固，北蛮依旧虎视眈眈，万万不可轻易卸权啊！”
五年戍边，铁寻柳早已是北境军心所向、百姓所依。十万镇边军只认铁将军号令，不认朝堂文书。骤然换将，军心必乱，一旦北蛮趁机起兵来犯，千里边关必将危在旦夕。
铁寻柳指尖摩挲着圣旨微凉的云锦，眼底深沉如水，看不出喜怒，唯有周身气压愈发冷冽。他沉默良久，风雪吹乱他额前碎发，落在他轮廓凌厉的眉眼之间，添了几分孤绝。
“君命如山，不可违。”
他缓缓吐出五个字，声音平静无波，却带着一丝难以掩饰的沉重。
他比谁都清楚，这道突如其来的急诏，绝非寻常调令。五年安稳戍边，朝堂从未过问北境军务，如今寒冬腊月、边关紧绷之际，帝王突然急召他卸权归京，其中必然藏着未知的风波与算计。
萧景渊登基七年，日渐沉稳多疑，早年尚且对戍边将领多有体恤，如今皇权稳固，最忌惮的便是手握重兵、镇守一方的边疆大将。他五年不回京，避开朝堂党争，低调守边，依旧没能避开帝王的猜忌与制衡。
或许是朝堂有人进献谗言，构陷他拥兵自重；或许是皇权制衡，要收回他手中的兵权；更或许，是京城暗流涌动，需要他这柄染血的边关利刃，回去破局，亦或是，回去受控。
种种猜测盘旋心头，却无半分头绪。
“传我将令。”铁寻柳收起圣旨，抬眸之时，眼底所有情绪尽数收敛，恢复了往日的冷静威严，“即刻召集诸将大帐议事，交接北境防务军务。”
林策心头焦急，依旧不死心：“将军！您若此时归京，数年心血付诸东流，且回京之后吉凶难测啊！不如属下快马递折，恳请陛下暂缓调令，待开春边关安稳再行回京！”
铁寻柳转头看他，目光沉静而通透：“暂缓？陛下既发御鹰急诏，便是心意已决，不容置喙。抗旨不遵，便是谋逆开端，届时不止我一人获罪，北境全军、铁氏满门，皆会被株连。”
他戍边五年，保的从来不止是北境山河，更是身后的家国朝堂、族人百姓。他可以不惧生死，却不能连累万千将士与无辜族人。
风雪愈发猛烈，城楼上的旗帜被吹得簌簌作响，烈烈风声中，似有无形的枷锁，悄然套上他的肩头。

半个时辰后，镇北军主帅大帐内，诸将齐聚。
一众身着铠甲、满身风霜的边关将领，看着案上那道明黄色圣旨，人人神色凝重，帐内气氛压抑得近乎窒息。所有人都清楚，铁将军是北境的定海神针，神针一去，边关必乱。
“将军，不能走！”一名老将拱手抱拳，声音铿锵，带着满心恳切，“北蛮近日小动作不断，暗中集结兵力，分明是伺机而动。此时换将，军心浮动，敌寇必趁机来犯！我等愿联名上书，恳请陛下收回成命！”
content_en:
The twenty-seventh year of the Apocalypse, winter.
The snow in the north is always more severe than in the Central Plains. The heavy snow continued for half a month, completely freezing the Yanmen border pass that stretched thousands of miles away, leaving only a dead whiteness in the vast sky and earth. The biting north wind rolled up the broken snow and hit it hard against the bluestone city wall of Yanmen Pass, making a whimpering whistle, like countless dead souls wailing in the wilderness. The crenellations of the city wall are covered with thick ice edges, layer upon layer, as sharp as a blade, reflecting the dim skylight, glowing with a biting cold light.
Above the city gate, Tie Xunliu, dressed in heavy black iron armor, stood quietly in the wind and snow.
His body was as tall as a pine, his back straight, and his shoulders carried the wind, frost and weight accumulated from years of guarding the border. The black iron armor has been battle-tested for a long time, and is covered with knife marks and arrow wounds of varying depths. Every line is the mark of a bloody battle. Unmelted ice and snow and dried dark red blood scabs are embedded in the gaps between the armor plates. The old and new are intertwined in a shocking way. The cold wind lifted the black cloak on his shoulders, and the wide hem of the clothes rustled, drawing sharp arcs in the white snow, which made his aura cold and solemn, calm and intimidating.
Tie Xunliu stationed at Yanmen for five years.
For five years, he guarded the throat of the northern border with a long cold iron sword, forcibly blocking the Northern Barbarian cavalry from attacking southward many times, making it difficult for them to advance even an inch. Everyone says that if there are iron trees in the north, the country will be safe and the people will have peace of mind. There is even a proverb among the people: Iron blades guard the border, and you can't cross the river in wind and snow. For the Dajing Dynasty, Tie Xunliu was no longer just a general on the border, but a reassurance for the people in the north, and the sharpest and most reliable blade for the court to resist foreign aggression.
At this moment, he lowered his eyes and looked at the vast snowfield outside the pass, his eyes as dark as a cold pool, without any waves. On the snowy plains, withered grass and snow cover, and thousands of miles of frozen soil, you can occasionally see the ruins of a few desolate villages that were burned by the war, standing silently in the wind and snow, silently telling the tragedy of the wars in previous years. The land beneath our feet is soaked in the blood of the soldiers, where countless loyal bones are buried, and is also engraved with his perseverance and bravery in guarding the border for five years.
"General, the wind and snow are too strong. Let's go into the tent to avoid the cold." Lin Ce, the commander of the army, stepped forward quickly, his armor covered with white snow, with a bit of anxiety and respect on his brows. "The soldiers have completed their rounds of patrolling the city. There has been no movement in the northern barbarians recently, and there are no hidden dangers for the time being."
Tie Xunliu shook his head slightly, his voice was low and hoarse due to the north wind blowing all year round, with a heavy wind and frost: "The more wind and snow seal the pass, the less we can relax. The Northern Barbarians are best at sneaking up on snowy nights, so don't take it lightly."
He raised his hand and stroked the cold handle of the knife at his waist. This cold iron long sword has been with him for ten years in battles. The blade has been hacked and killed countless times, and it is still cold and piercing. The blade is extremely sharp. When unsheathed, it can cut through wind and snow, and can break the courage of enemies. After five years of guarding the border and more than 70 major and minor battles, he relied on this sword to guard Yanmen, break enemy formations, and protect the common people, without ever being defeated.
Lin Ce bowed in response after hearing this, but the worry in his brows had not dissipated: "The general has been guarding the border for five years, guarding the cold in winter, and bathing in the wind and sand in summer. He has never stopped. Many generals in the court return to the capital every year, but the general sticks to this place and has never returned to the capital."
Hearing this, Tie Xunliu pursed his thin lips slightly, and a faint hint of indifference flashed across his eyes.
It's not that he doesn't want to return to Beijing, he just doesn't dare and can't.
He has 100,000 elite soldiers on the border in the north. He has military power and guards the key areas of the dynasty. His high achievements are the easiest to sway the master. Today's sage, Xiao Jingyuan, has ascended the throne as a young man. The city is deep and his thoughts are unpredictable. The most important thing is that he is worried about the self-respect of the border generals. Five years ago, he took the initiative to request orders to guard the northern border and stay away from court disputes. This was not only to protect the peace of his family and country, but also to avoid the suspicion of the court, and to seek peace between the king and his ministers and peace on the border.
The capital city is prosperous and turbulent, and it has never been a place where he should stay for a long time. The border is bitter and cold, but the victory is magnanimity and purity. Knife versus knife, gun versus gun, victory or defeat depends on strength, which is far better than the intrigues and undercurrents above the court.
Just as the two of them were whispering, a sharp and sharp eagle call suddenly came from the distant sky., piercing the silence of the wind and snow.
Tie Xunliu's eyes suddenly condensed and he raised his eyes to the sky. I saw a jet-black royal messenger eagle, fluttering its wings and galloping through the biting wind and snow. Its wings fluttered, shaking off pieces of white snow. It flew straight towards the Yanmenguan Tower at extremely fast speeds.
Lin Ce's face suddenly became solemn: "It's the Imperial Eagle from the capital! Urgent secret message!"
Ordinary military information and local documents are all delivered by fast horses at the inn. Only emergency orders and top-secret information exclusive to the palace will be used by the royal eagle. Moreover, the imperial eagle traveled thousands of miles and came through the snow, which shows that the situation is urgent and is by no means an ordinary matter.
In an instant, the imperial eagle landed on the railing of the city tower, with a black brocade pouch firmly tied on its talons. The body of the pouch was embroidered with fine golden dragon patterns. It was an exclusive regulation of the royal family and could be recognized at a glance.
Lin Ce stepped forward and carefully untied the brocade bag without any hesitation. He held it in both hands and handed it to Tie Xunliu: "General, this is an urgent edict from the palace."
Tie Xunliu stretched out his hand to take it, and when his fingertips touched the cool touch of the brocade bag, a trace of depression rose up in his heart. He used his fingertips to open the seal of the brocade bag and took out a bright yellow imperial edict.
The material of the imperial edict is high-quality cloud brocade. The dragon pattern woven with gold thread is majestic and solemn. The ink characters are neat and sharp. The words are all written by the emperor. The strokes are calm and restrained, carrying the imperial majesty that cannot be ignored. Just a few lines of text caused Tie Xunliu's originally calm eyes to completely stir up waves.
[By God's blessing, the emperor issued an edict: General Zhenbei Tie Xunliu guarded the border for five years, guarding the country's gates, and his hard work has made great achievements. There is something going on in the capital today. I urgently summon Tie Xunliu to relinquish his military power immediately, return to the capital lightly, and return to the court immediately without delay. The military affairs in the northern border are temporarily in charge of the deputy general. I appreciate this. 】
The words are concise and the sentences are decisive.
There was no reason, no foreshadowing, no explanation of what happened in the capital, just a cold edict, ordering him to immediately relinquish the military power in the north that had guarded the northern border for five years and return to the capital as soon as possible.
Lin Ce stood aside and secretly caught a glimpse of the contents of the imperial edict. His face instantly turned pale, and his whole body felt chilly. He had followed Tie Xunliu for many years and was well aware of the weight of this urgent edict. His heart suddenly tightened and he said in a low voice: "General! Why did His Majesty suddenly summon you back to the capital? At this time, the northern border has just been decided, and the people's morale and the military's morale are not stable. The northern barbarians are still eyeing him, so we must not relinquish power easily!"
After five years of guarding the border, Tie Xunliu has long been the heart of the northern border troops and the support of the people. The 100,000-strong border army only recognized General Tie's orders and did not recognize court documents. A sudden change of generals will demoralize the army. Once the Northern Barbarians take the opportunity to invade, the border crossing thousands of miles away will be in danger.
Tie Xunliu's fingertips rubbed the slightly cool cloud brocade of the imperial edict, his eyes were as deep as water, showing no emotion or anger, only the air pressure around his body became increasingly cold. He was silent for a long time, the wind and snow ruffled his broken hair on his forehead, falling between his sharp brows and eyes, adding a bit of loneliness.
"Your order is like a mountain and cannot be violated."
He slowly uttered five words, his voice calm but with a hint of heaviness that was difficult to conceal.
He knew better than anyone that this sudden and urgent edict was by no means an ordinary order. After five years of guarding the border safely, the court never interfered with the military affairs of the northern border. Now, in the cold winter months and the border was tense, the emperor suddenly summoned him to relinquish power and return to the capital. There must be unknown turmoil and calculations hidden in it.
Xiao Jingyuan has been on the throne for seven years, and has become increasingly calm and suspicious. In his early years, he was very considerate of the border generals. Now that the imperial power is stable, the most fearful thing is the border generals who hold heavy troops and guard one side. He did not return to Beijing for five years, avoided party disputes in the court, and kept a low profile at the border. He still failed to avoid the emperor's suspicion and checks and balances.
Perhaps someone in the court was making slanderous remarks to frame him for supporting the army; perhaps it was the imperial power that wanted to take back the military power in his hands; perhaps more perhaps, there was an undercurrent in the capital, and he needed his blood-stained border blade to go back to break the situation, or to go back and control it.
All kinds of speculations are swirling in my mind, but I don’t have a clue.
"Pass my general's order." Tie Xunliu put away the imperial edict. When he raised his eyes, all the emotions in his eyes calmed down and he returned to his former calm and majestic state. "That's it.Immediately summon the generals to discuss matters in the big tent and hand over the defense and military affairs of the northern border. "
Lin Ce was anxious but still refused to give up: "General! If you return to Beijing at this time, several years of hard work will be in vain, and your fortune after returning to Beijing will be unpredictable! Why don't you send the discount quickly? I beg Your Majesty to postpone the transfer order until the border is stable in spring before returning to Beijing! "
Tie Xunliu turned to look at him, his eyes calm and transparent: "Delay? Now that His Majesty has issued the urgent edict to control the eagle, he has made up his mind and cannot be criticized. Disobeying the order is the beginning of rebellion. At that time, not only I will be guilty, but the entire army in the north and the entire Tie family will be implicated. "
He has guarded the border for five years, and has always protected not only the mountains and rivers of the northern border, but also the family, country, court, clan and people behind him. He can not be afraid of life and death, but he cannot harm thousands of soldiers and innocent people.
The wind and snow became more and more fierce, and the flags on the tower were blown rustling. In the strong wind, there seemed to be invisible shackles quietly put on his shoulders.
Half an hour later, all the generals gathered in the commander's tent of Zhenbei Army.
A group of armored and weathered border generals looked at the bright yellow edict on the case, their expressions solemn, and the atmosphere in the tent was so depressing that it was almost suffocating. Everyone knows that General Tie is the magic needle that anchors the sea in the north. Once the magic needle is gone, the border will be in chaos.
"General, you can't leave! "A veteran general cupped his hands and clasped his fists, his voice sonorous and full of sincerity, "The Northern Barbarians have been making small moves recently, secretly gathering troops, obviously waiting for opportunities. At this time, the generals are changed and the morale of the army is unstable. The enemy will take the opportunity to invade! We would like to jointly submit a letter to implore Your Majesty to withdraw your order! "
